value.rationale: The originating social-dynamics paper studies switching-induced multimodality and uses finite-speed simulations. Whether increasing environmental speed necessarily lowers a natural polarization observable is an independently motivated structural question; the theorem settles it sharply at all finite population sizes and positive rates, with a measurable two-agent agreement interpretation and exact crossover parameter. It is not merely a numeric example, static-noise substitution or arbitrary slice.
